newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China to grant foreign bnks RMB licences soon - PBOC.
newsitem.headline: China to grant foreign bnks RMB licences soon - PBOC.

text.p: The deputy governor of the People's Bank of China, Chen Yuan, said on Tuesday that China would grant licences for foreign banks to conduct local currency renminbi business "very soon".

"We will very soon introduce foreign banks into the renminbi business in Shanghai," he told reporters after a Hong Kong Monetary Authority conference here. "We will announce that very soon. It is a matter of days not weeks," Chen said.
He declined to say how many licences would be granted.
The official Shanghai Star newspaper reported on Tuesday that China would grant licences to three foreign banks this month to do local currency renminbi business.
It said the three banks were Citibank, Tokyo-Mitsubishi Bank and Hong Kong & Shanghai Banking Corp.
